assumptions: This predicate concerns the selected applicability condition, not whole-law compliance or licence possession.
Case-dependent input classifications and incorporated authority remain external to the encoded predicate.
The declared input vocabulary is supplied for this controlled comparison; its adequacy as a legal abstraction remains unverified.

The supplied ra13_context input is assumed to capture receipt or holding by the relevant LC or its AE in the course of Type 13 activity conducted by the LC; generic payment processing alone does not establish that condition.

citations.quote: The CMR will apply to an RA 13 licensed corporation (LC) and its associated entity (AE) in respect of “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong by the RA 13 LC or its AE in the course of conducting Type 13 regulated activity by the RA 13 LC, regardless of the role played by such LC.

That said, in the context of RA 13, handling of money which is not “scheme money” received or held in Hong Kong will not be subject to the CMR. In such cases, the depositary is expected to observe relevant requirements under Schedule 11 to the Code of Conduct for Persons Licensed by or Registered with the Securities and Futures Commission (Schedule 11), in particular paragraphs 9 (relating to how subscription and redemption proceeds should be held) and 11 (relating to distribution proceeds).

Where REIT collection or operating accounts are opened in the name of SPVs and the RA 13 LC only operates those accounts in accordance with the management company’s instructions, the monies in those accounts are unlikely to be considered scheme money received or held by the RA 13 LC.

readings.distinction: Considered attachments before preference: (1) the final modifier makes the LC's role irrelevant to the entire stated applicability trigger; (2) it makes the LC's role irrelevant within the immediately preceding Type 13 activity condition. Both preserve the same express conditions and produce the same predicate. Restricting the answer to transfer-agent activities would contradict “regardless”; treating that modifier as dispensing with Type 13 conduct would erase an express condition. A further possible extension—treating every operational role as receipt or holding—is undermined by Q3's distinction between operating SPV accounts and receiving or holding their money. No substantive missing rival antecedent is defensible on this text, so one reading is retained. The remaining actor-reference and negative-qualification ambiguities are recorded without manufacturing a second predicate.

readings.statement: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] True means that the selected Q1 applicability antecedent is satisfied: ra13_context, scheme_money and in_hong_kong all hold. Transfer-agent status neither supplies an additional requirement nor creates an exception. False does not establish absence of Schedule 11 duties or determine whole-law compliance; unknown inputs are not assigned truth values.

vocabulary_concerns: ra13_context compresses actor identity, associated-entity status, receipt or holding, and the connection to the LC's Type 13 activity. Its supplied reference to handling funds is potentially broader than receipt or holding; the encoding depends on the stated interpretation assumption.

transfer_agent describes only the LC's role. It cannot distinguish LC and AE roles or represent alternative syntactic attachments, although the defensible attachments yield the same Boolean antecedent.

in_hong_kong is defined for scheme money and cannot independently locate non-scheme money. The competing attachments of Q1's subsequent negation therefore cannot be fully represented for purposes of Schedule 11's reach.
The vocabulary cannot encode Schedule 11 duties, their different modal formulations, or their satisfaction. The source's continuing expectations remain outside this antecedent.

scheme_money incorporates legal definitions not supplied here. The inputs cannot independently express Q2's unknown-receipt policy, contrary evidence, or Q3's qualified account classifications; those passages do not justify inventing categorical exclusions.
